reference_runtime: 170 offline upstream component assertions passed. One original real-media fixture exercised the inspection parser. Per-capability scope is in ../parity.csv and runtime-check.md. End-to-end reference runtime pending.

rows.description: Local reference inspection
rows.inputs: A locally supplied media file
rows.outputs: Stream kinds, container, dimensions, duration and timing
rows.criterion: Probe silent, audio-only and multi-stream fixtures. Retain which observed facts belong to which stream.

rows.description: Reference from an authorized media link
rows.inputs: Permitted HTTP or HTTPS media link and destination
rows.outputs: One local media file or explicit acquisition failure
rows.criterion: Download an owned test clip from a permitted service. Validate the resulting media and preserve an occupied destination.

rows.description: Select and extract evidence from a time interval
rows.inputs: Video, time or interval, optional transcript phrase and occurrence
rows.outputs: Trimmed clip, timed still frames or contact sheets
rows.criterion: Resolve two occurrences of a repeated phrase. Match the exported pictures and times to the requested occurrence.

rows.description: Find candidate visual changes
rows.inputs: Source footage and sensitivity settings
rows.outputs: Timed mechanical change scores
rows.criterion: Detect a hard cut in a known fixture. Show its time and distinguish a flash candidate from an editorial decision.

rows.description: Prepare a visual storyboard for inspection
rows.inputs: A completed video artifact
rows.outputs: Evenly sampled overview pictures with timing information
rows.criterion: Map several pictures back to the correct source times without treating them as generated shot ideas.

rows.description: Word-level speech evidence
rows.inputs: Audio or video, language and an available transcription service
rows.outputs: Words with aligned times, normalized output and available confidence
rows.criterion: Transcribe an authorized accented line in the specified language. Listen at each word boundary and preserve missing timings.

rows.description: Reference reading by a directing agent
rows.inputs: Reference and its frame, timing and speech evidence
rows.outputs: Time-located observations and an interpretation of hook, structure, motion, graphics, audio and intended response
rows.criterion: Give an original authorized example to an agent and trace every observation to its moment. Label inferred strategy and unavailable performance.

rows.description: Capture original browser material
rows.inputs: A permitted page and selected still area or recording interval
rows.outputs: Screenshot or timed recording with dimensions
rows.criterion: Capture an owned local page in a box and as a recording. Inspect the returned image bounds and measured video duration.

rows.description: Create a production from a brief, reference or starting design
rows.inputs: Direction and optional example
rows.outputs: Agent-authored, editable production plan and sources
rows.criterion: Follow the three entry paths with original materials. Reopen and change the resulting projects.

rows.description: Author structured dialogue, narration and display copy
rows.inputs: Script with speakers, pauses, alternate readings and text selections
rows.outputs: Distinct speech, dialogue and caption views with named markers
rows.criterion: Correct a spoken pronunciation while preserving the display spelling. Follow a repeated phrase across speech and captions.

rows.description: Estimate an unrecorded reading duration
rows.inputs: Script, speech policy, language and delivery rate
rows.outputs: Predicted speaking time
rows.criterion: Change delivery rate and verify the prediction changes. Replace the estimate with measured timing when the recording arrives.

rows.description: Use spoken words, segments and pauses to drive picture timing
rows.inputs: Approved script and word timing evidence
rows.outputs: Media-linked scene, event and caption times
rows.criterion: Change the performance and confirm graphics and words realign, including duplicate words, a pause and unmatched speech.

rows.description: Author time independently of dialogue
rows.inputs: An explicit clock, event offsets, windows and media duration
rows.outputs: Frame-resolved events and bounded intervals
rows.criterion: Render a silent sequence and align two separate layers to a shared event at a fractional frame rate.

rows.description: Validate a project and plan only the requested work
rows.inputs: Project sources, configuration and requested products
rows.outputs: Validation result and dependency plan
rows.criterion: A missing required asset fails preflight. Planning just one scene does not demand an unrelated generation.

rows.description: Select previously produced or supplied material
rows.inputs: History record or external material and intended use
rows.outputs: A reused input with known identity, explicitly selected for a run
rows.criterion: Reuse an accepted intro in another revision, preserve its identity and show that the planner omits its generation.

rows.description: Branch variations and share work between outputs
rows.inputs: Common project plus changed author choices or media selections
rows.outputs: Independent outputs with shared unchanged material
rows.criterion: Render two hooks, compare the surviving scene assets and check shared work executes once under a single plan.

rows.description: Extend a project with separately authored capabilities
rows.inputs: Project component, provider or editor integration
rows.outputs: Selectable capability with optional controls and validation
rows.criterion: A new test component renders and exposes only supported edits. An incompatible value fails before external execution.

rows.description: Discover installed authoring capabilities and versioned packages
rows.inputs: Installed distribution and project packages
rows.outputs: Inspectible capabilities available to that configuration
rows.criterion: Compare installations with and without one optional component. Each listing reflects its installed packages.

rows.description: Reuse model directions and appearance choices
rows.inputs: A reusable project-owned direction or style definition plus parameters
rows.outputs: Several dependent assets using the selected direction
rows.criterion: Modify an independently authored style and inspect which selected scenes consume it. Create the reusable materials locally.

rows.description: Generate moving footage from text
rows.inputs: Scene direction, duration, supported model and service
rows.outputs: Provider-generated video artifact
rows.criterion: Run an approved real request, save its operation ID, decode the result and inspect subject motion across frames.

rows.description: Animate a source image or bridge two endpoint images
rows.inputs: Authorized opening image, optional closing image and prompt
rows.outputs: Conditioned generated clip
rows.criterion: Submit original endpoints to a qualifying model and inspect subject motion and recognizable beginning and ending.

rows.description: Condition a new shot on visual and audio references
rows.inputs: Authorized video, image or audio references and a new shot description
rows.outputs: New generated footage conditioned on the selected inputs
rows.criterion: Evaluate new footage against licensed timing or subject references. Record actual inputs sent and distinguish a generated shot from extracted source frames.

rows.description: Direct motion, camera, recurring subjects and product shots
rows.inputs: Shot direction, subject references and cross-shot composition choices
rows.outputs: Directed clips whose continuity requires creative review
rows.criterion: Generate two shots of an owned fictional product. Review camera movement, subject identity and unsupported factual claims.

rows.description: Choose clip length, framing, resolution and optional generated sound
rows.inputs: Supported model settings and direction
rows.outputs: Clip with declared targets and measured output properties
rows.criterion: Exercise supported settings and reject incompatible ones. Probe the returned file including the presence of a real audio stream.

rows.description: Request model-specific multi-shot and timed guidance
rows.inputs: Qualifying model, scene switches or timed media references
rows.outputs: A generated sequence with provider-specific conditioning
rows.criterion: Exercise each supported mode independently. Check the billed model, shot changes and input timing.

rows.description: Generate still images from descriptions
rows.inputs: Prompt, supported image model and output choices
rows.outputs: Generated image assets
rows.criterion: Verify an actual image, its dimensions, model and provenance using an approved request.

rows.description: Adapt or vary images from authorized still references
rows.inputs: Reference image set and original image direction
rows.outputs: New conditioned image candidate or candidates
rows.criterion: Use an owned product image, compare the new pose or setting and review brand fidelity.

rows.description: Create related images and multiple image candidates
rows.inputs: Eligible model with options for number or an image set
rows.outputs: Multiple returned pictures or related set within supported limits
rows.criterion: Request a supported number of images and preserve distinct output identities. Reject invalid setting combinations.

rows.description: Apply deterministic image cleanup and transformations
rows.inputs: Raster image and ordered crop, resize, rotate, flip, noise, color, sharpness, blur, alpha or output format settings
rows.outputs: Processed raster asset
rows.criterion: Use a known RGBA target and verify dimensions, orientation, transparency and operation order.

rows.description: Composite images on a canvas
rows.inputs: Ordered image layers, placement, fit, opacity and backdrop
rows.outputs: Flattened image composition
rows.criterion: Use two translucent layers, switch their order and compare a known overlap pixel.

rows.description: Separate a portrait foreground from video
rows.inputs: Authorized person footage and supported service
rows.outputs: Video matte or alpha-bearing foreground
rows.criterion: Assess the boundary on a consenting subject. Composite over a different background and verify alpha survives storage.

rows.description: Generate a spoken performance using a selected voice
rows.inputs: Script, eligible voice, speed, language and model settings
rows.outputs: Synthesized voice recording
rows.criterion: Speak a rights-cleared test line, check transcript and timing, and retain the selected voice and usage.

rows.description: Design an original voice from a description
rows.inputs: Voice direction and spoken text
rows.outputs: Speech in a newly described voice
rows.criterion: Create two permitted voice directions and compare the recordings against the requested traits.

rows.description: Generate speech using a consenting reference voice
rows.inputs: Authorized voice sample(s), rights record and script
rows.outputs: New speech conditioned on a reference voice
rows.criterion: Exercise a permitted synthetic or personal voice with documented authorization. Retain the source rights and verify the spoken line.

rows.description: Generate sound effects
rows.inputs: Description and optional duration or loop setting
rows.outputs: New sound effect asset
rows.criterion: Generate and audition an original timed effect. Probe the returned file and compare its length and timing.

rows.description: Generate original music or adapt a licensed musical source
rows.inputs: Music direction, optional lyrics or reference audio, eligible model
rows.outputs: Generated music or cover audio
rows.criterion: Test original music and a separately authorized adaptation. Audition both and retain the rights for lyrics and source recording.

rows.description: Compose multiple picture and sound tracks in one project
rows.inputs: Project canvas, clock, timed visual clips, audio tracks and overlays
rows.outputs: Ordered composition with program extent
rows.criterion: Overlap two visuals, two audio clips and an overlay. Inspect ordering at known times.

rows.description: Place, crop and fit media for different aspect ratios
rows.inputs: Canvas, source dimensions, destination frame and anchoring
rows.outputs: Composed picture with preserved or intentionally cropped geometry
rows.criterion: Repeat the same composition in portrait, square and landscape. Verify subject position and text-safe bounds at matched times.

rows.description: Control sample timing, trim and motion across a visual placement
rows.inputs: Timed video or still, source ranges, motion and appearance
rows.outputs: Edited clip with frame-dependent sampling, scale, position and treatments
rows.criterion: Time-shift a clip, hold one frame and animate an image. Compare selected output frames to planned source samples.

rows.description: Layer animated graphics and create transitions
rows.inputs: Timed visual states, opacity, positions, scripted composition or effect
rows.outputs: Frame-driven transitions, graphics-only shots and overlays
rows.criterion: Place a timed transition over a shot boundary and compare the picture at its start, middle and end.

rows.description: Add typography, reusable fonts and styled text
rows.inputs: Text, licensed font files, style and motion
rows.outputs: Rendered text layers
rows.criterion: Render multilingual text with the selected font, inspect line breaks and reopen the project.

rows.description: Build word-synchronized and speaker-aware captions
rows.inputs: Display words, speaker identities, aligned times and presentation
rows.outputs: Timed captions with highlights, wrapping and animated styles
rows.criterion: Check a timed word highlight, a speaker switch and two lines against the actual audio and encoded picture.

rows.description: Position captions or overlays using tracked regions
rows.inputs: Timed region evidence and target canvas
rows.outputs: Picture-relative overlay position over time
rows.criterion: Supply known moving boxes and missing observations. Check overlay placement on known frames and uncertainty where tracking is absent.

rows.description: Edit and mix dialogue, music and sound effects
rows.inputs: Source audio, ranges, timing, levels, fade or audibility changes
rows.outputs: Sample-timed mix with permitted overlap
rows.criterion: Measure a sync click and two overlapping tones before and after fades. Verify clipping and end length.

rows.description: Normalize and separate heterogeneous media
rows.inputs: Selected container streams and target clock
rows.outputs: Prepared video, audio or single frame with measured properties
rows.criterion: Normalize mismatched frame rates, rotation and audio stream selection. Reject cover art selected as moving footage.

rows.description: Create explicit still-image sequences
rows.inputs: One or more stills with chosen segment weights and duration
rows.outputs: A timed video encoding of held pictures
rows.criterion: Count output frames and verify each hold duration. Store the source type as still imagery.

rows.description: Package reusable graphic treatments
rows.inputs: Ranking data, timed item reveals, comments, icons or multiple depth layers
rows.outputs: Timed rank/tier/top-three graphics, reveal overlays, stickers or layered scenes
rows.criterion: Build original layouts for each treatment. Verify timed reveals, persistence, stacking and accompanying sounds with authorized assets.

rows.description: Preview the same composition used for offline rendering
rows.inputs: Resolved material and a saved composition
rows.outputs: Interactive player with scrubbing, stepping and shared layout/motion behavior
rows.criterion: Compare a timeout-free sample of scrubbed frames to encoded frames, including a clip edge and animated typography.

rows.description: Inspect or edit a project in a graphical timeline
rows.inputs: Saved project, presented tracks and selected element
rows.outputs: Inspectable timeline and editable source parameters with controlled writeback
rows.criterion: Drag one supported timing handle, reopen and verify duration. Invalid or stale edits cannot corrupt the prior version.

rows.description: Review and resolve comments at a timecode
rows.inputs: Reviewer note and a position in the project
rows.outputs: Persisted notes that navigate to their source time
rows.criterion: Add two notes, reopen, seek from each and mark one complete. Preserve their times.

rows.description: Inspect project artifacts, jobs and source changes
rows.inputs: Saved project and run history
rows.outputs: Library of source, outputs and operation activity, with reloading
rows.criterion: Replace one owned source externally and refresh the view. Prior outputs and current selections retain their identities.

rows.description: Localize editor controls
rows.inputs: Browser or chosen locale
rows.outputs: English or Simplified Chinese interface with stored preference
rows.criterion: Change language while a comment or timeline selection is active. The project copy and playhead retain their meaning.

rows.description: Render exact review frames and partial output
rows.inputs: Frame numbers or windows in a compiled composition
rows.outputs: Selected frames, labeled grids or range render
rows.criterion: Render just the transition window. Check original frame numbers and compare against matching frames in a full export.

rows.description: Encode video at a reproducible frame clock
rows.inputs: Assembled visual composition and available local encoder
rows.outputs: H.264 MP4 plus checked frame count, size and stream properties
rows.criterion: Render a fractional-rate composition twice from retained material. Decode all frames and compare timing, dimensions and ordered content.

rows.description: Mux an audio mix with final encoded pictures
rows.inputs: Finished visual stream and aligned audio
rows.outputs: Final playable MP4 with synchronized audio
rows.criterion: Decode the whole file and measure a first, middle and final visual/audio marker against expected timing.

rows.description: Process alpha and animated image input
rows.inputs: Original alpha-bearing source or animated WebP
rows.outputs: Prepared alpha-preserving media or correctly composited frames
rows.criterion: Compare known transparent and disposed frames over different backdrops.

rows.description: Expose an interactive browser-playable document
rows.inputs: Composition, asset locations and playback options
rows.outputs: Browser document or compiled visual program for project playback
rows.criterion: Play a local export using its declared assets and verify time and position before and after seeking.

rows.description: Select exact service capabilities and supported inputs
rows.inputs: Model selection, credentials, profile and requested modality
rows.outputs: Chosen supported endpoint or actionable diagnostic
rows.criterion: Use a supported and an unsupported request. Confirm the latter causes no external work or fallback charge.

rows.description: Route generation across seven shipped service integrations
rows.inputs: Explicit choice of HypiHub, HiAPI, BeatAPI, Pollo, Sume, TokenDance or Monid and a supported request
rows.outputs: Mapped media request, eventual provider result or error
rows.criterion: For each contract identified in the provider register, record setup, a permitted real operation and resulting media or a specific block.

rows.description: Prepare the selected local tools and credentials
rows.inputs: Local profile, model resources and OS or environment credential source
rows.outputs: Readiness diagnostics and a configured runtime
rows.criterion: Report a missing binary, model and credential without logging any secrets. Verify a working configuration independently.

rows.description: Estimate exposure before generation
rows.inputs: Selected output, dependency graph and available provider pricing documents
rows.outputs: Planned local or paid calls and pricing evidence or missing prices
rows.criterion: Prevent an estimate from being recorded as actual cost. Mark missing price and preserve its provider source.

rows.description: Submit, poll and retain operation identity
rows.inputs: Prepared job, credentials and accepted request
rows.outputs: Stable external operation receipt, pending/terminal result and artifacts
rows.criterion: Restart after acceptance. Reconcile the existing ID before any further charge and verify output identity.

rows.description: Recover partial work and keep failures visible
rows.inputs: Interrupted execution, retained receipts and finished results
rows.outputs: Recoverable or terminal build with exact failed work and surviving outputs
rows.criterion: Inject an interruption after one of two clips finishes. Recover the finished clip and handle uncertain provider state explicitly.

rows.description: Cancel work and reconcile the actual outcome
rows.inputs: Cancellation of an active or queued build
rows.outputs: Recorded stop request and available provider/build terminal evidence
rows.criterion: Cancel before submission and after provider acceptance. Distinguish local cancellation, remote termination and charges.

rows.description: Limit concurrent work and render frames in order
rows.inputs: Several runs, resource limits and eligible tasks
rows.outputs: Bounded simultaneous work and ordered output
rows.criterion: Execute two builds under the same limit, inspect peaks and compare output frame ordering with sequential rendering.

rows.description: Record execution progress and project output history
rows.inputs: Live or completed build, requested artifact or search scope
rows.outputs: Progress, errors, operation IDs, versioned outputs and notes
rows.criterion: Find a failed and a completed build by project and output, then match an exported artifact to its producing operation.

rows.description: Export an individual result safely
rows.inputs: Build result, named output and destination
rows.outputs: Validated exported file or meaningful error
rows.criterion: Export a saved media artifact, verify its bytes and reject an unsafe or conflicting destination.

rows.description: Store and stage only required media
rows.inputs: Referenced resources, workspace and render range
rows.outputs: Local project artifacts and staged render inputs
rows.criterion: Request a short render window. Verify it loads only needed files and cleans up interrupted staging.

rows.description: Use local speech alignment or an explicitly selected hosted service
rows.inputs: Selected language, model resources and authorized speech
rows.outputs: Word timestamps or a specific service/preparation failure
rows.criterion: Compare local and hosted evidence on a rights-cleared clip. Record the route, resource availability and quality separately.
